name: Trade Leg Notification V 05
definition: Scope|The TradeLegNotification message is sent by the central counterparty (CCP) to a clearing member to report the trade that has been executed by the trading platform.||The message definition is intended for use with the ISO20022 Business Application Header.||Usage|The CCP reports both sides of the trade from the clearing member perspective. The CCP sends a message to the global clearing member of the seller and a message to the global clearing member of the buyer. Note: An individual clearing member only clear its own trades.

ClearingMember.name: Clearing Member
ClearingMember.definition: Provides the identification of the clearing member (individual clearing member or general clearing member).

ClearingAccount.name: Clearing Account
ClearingAccount.definition: Identifies the clearing member account at the CCP through which the trade must be cleared (sometimes called position account).

DeliveryAccount.name: Delivery Account
DeliveryAccount.definition: An account opened by the central counterparty in the name of the clearing member or its settlement agent within the account structure, for settlement purposes (gives information about the clearing member/its settlement agent account at the central securities depository).

NonClearingMember.name: Non Clearing Member
NonClearingMember.definition: Provides details about the non clearing member identification and account.

ClearingDetails.name: Clearing Details
ClearingDetails.definition: Provides clearing details such as the settlement netting (or not) eligibility code or the clearing segment.

TradeLegDetails.name: Trade Leg Details
TradeLegDetails.definition: Provides details about the trade leg such as the trade date, the settlement date or the trading currency.

SettlementDetails.name: Settlement Details
SettlementDetails.definition: Provides details about the settlement details of the trade leg such the settlement amount or the place of settlement.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.

DepositoryOrPlaceOfListingPresenceRule.definition: Depository or PlaceOfListing must be present.
